name: Cyclazocine
summary: Cyclazocine is a mixed opioid agonist/antagonist related to dezocine, pentazocine and phenazocine. It is in the benzomorphan and benzazocine family of drugs. It is a κ-opioid receptor agonist and μ-opioid receptor partial agonist, and also has high affinity for the δ-opioid receptor.

pharmacology.text: Cyclazocine is a mixed opioid agonist/antagonist related to dezocine, pentazocine and phenazocine. It is a κ-opioid receptor agonist and μ-opioid receptor partial agonist, and also has high affinity for the δ-opioid receptor.

uses.text: Research into the use of cyclazocine for the treatment of bipolar patients with depression was undertaken by Fink and colleagues (1970). It showed that 8 out of 10 patients experienced moderate improvement. Research during the 1960s and 1970s into the possible use of cyclazocine for management of pain, and later for assisting treatment of opioid addiction was severely hampered by the drug's psychotomimetic, dysphoric, and hallucinatory effects.

summaryZh: 環佐辛（英語：Cyclazocine）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C18H25NO，化學結構上與噴他佐辛、地佐辛類似，都屬於苯嗎喃衍生物，可作為類阿片鎮痛藥。
